name: KV-cache checkpoint search KM-3 exactness gate
purpose: Start the KV-cache checkpoint-search redesign by running the KM-3 exactness gate before any search arm is interpreted. The gate tests whether truncating a cached Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B continuation to checkpoint lengths exactly restores the state needed for same-token resume and different-token resume versus a fresh prefix. The gate fails, so the new KV-cache checkpoint-search line is fail-closed until cache restore semantics are fixed or scoped to a pure-KV model/cache path.

provenance.parent_context: User supplied KV-cache checkpoint-search v1 spec; TTT-LoRA/textual-register path paused.

code_added_used.change: Adds KM-3 cache truncation exactness tests: resume_same and resume_different_equals_fresh, cache length assertions, crop path diagnostics, and cache layer inventory.
Records the KV-cache checkpoint-search claim, build order, exactness gate, single-agent mechanism, multi-agent extension, and honesty rules.

commands.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 .venv/bin/python -m analysis.kvcache_exactness_gate --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B --depth 16 --checkpoints 2,4,8,12 --tol 1e-3 --device cuda --dtype bf16 --out results/kvcache_exactness/km3_result.json
commands.purpose: Run KM-3 exactness gate on Qwen3.5 before any KV-cache checkpoint-search arms.

headline.single_next_move: Do not read any A/B/C/D KV-cache checkpoint-search arm. Either implement full checkpoint/restore of recurrent_states and conv_states as well as sequence cache, or rerun KM-3 on a pure causal-attention model/cache path.

gate_outcomes.number: DynamicCache.crop produced expected sequence lengths at checkpoints 26,28,32,36 and after-token lengths 27,29,33,37.
resume_same max_abs_logit_delta ranged from 4.90625 to 6.75, above tol=0.001, though argmax stayed equal after indexing fix.
different-token resume max_abs_logit_delta ranged from 4.296875 to 6.5625 with argmax flips at checkpoints 2,4,12.
cache inventory shows layer0 cache_layer_class=LinearAttentionLayer with recurrent_states shape [1,32,128,128] and conv_states shape [1,8192,4].
Spec kill rule triggers: no arm A/B/C/D result may be read until KM-3 passes.

decision.next_step_routing: Fix or rescope cache restore. For Qwen3.5, minimal checkpoint may need full cache-state snapshots including recurrent_states and conv_states, not just KV sequence truncation. Alternatively test a pure-KV causal-attention model before claiming KV truncation exactness.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish KV-cache checkpoint search, branch quality, backjump LoRA, or multi-agent cache search. It only runs the mandatory exactness gate and records a fail-closed result.
honesty.implementation_note: The first run had an off-by-one comparison for resume_same; the recorded artifact is from the corrected gate. resume_different_equals_fresh still fails.
honesty.model_scope_limit: Qwen3.5 exposes LinearAttentionLayer cache states with recurrent_states and conv_states. The user's pure KV truncation claim may require a pure causal-attention cache path or a broader full-cache-state checkpoint for this model.
